{'text': 'At Apple\'s "Surprise and Shine" event held today, the company confirmed the rollout schedule for the new Siri AI, which will debut in English first, before expanding to five additional languages in October. Here\'s everything you need to know.', 'empty': False}

{'text': 'Siri AI Language Expansion Confirmed for October Launch', 'empty': False}

{'text': 'In addition to unveiling the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, Apple also today announced its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo. The company additionally unveiled the Apple Watch Series 12 Ultra 4, as well as the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.', 'empty': False}

{'text': "The common thread with all of these devices is that they each rely on at least one feature of the new Siri AI — a more capable language model-powered assistant delivered via Apple's partnership with Google.", 'empty': False}

{'text': "Following Siri AI's debut at WWDC earlier this year, Apple today shared further details on the specific rollout plans for the languages it will support.", 'empty': False}

{'text': "Apple's VP of Product Marketing for AI, Lilian Rincon, said at the event that the new Siri AI will launch in English on the same day iOS 27 rolls out (tentatively September 14), with support for the following languages arriving throughout October:", 'empty': False}

  • {'text': 'French', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Japanese', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Korean', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Portuguese', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Spanish', 'empty': False}

{'text': "Rincon also confirmed two pieces of information first mentioned by Apple's Craig Federighi at WWDC earlier this year.", 'empty': False}

{'text': 'First, certain features will be subject to usage caps, because they rely on powerful server-side models, with most iCloud+ plans being allotted higher usage allowances.', 'empty': False}

{'text': "Second, Apple Intelligence (of which Siri AI is just one part) will support the following 16 languages in this month's OS updates:", 'empty': False}

  • {'text': 'English', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Simplified Chinese', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Traditional Chinese', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Danish', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Dutch', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'French', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'German', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Italian', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Japanese', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Korean', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Norwegian', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Portuguese', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Spanish', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Swedish', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Turkish', 'empty': False}
  • {'text': 'Vietnamese', 'empty': False}

{'text': "Apple noted that Apple Intelligence is not available in China, but it appears the company is actively working to bring these features to the Chinese market. Apple also said Siri AI will not launch in China or the EU — the latter due to Apple's ongoing disagreements with regulators over the Digital Markets Act.", 'empty': False}
